title: Verifiable rewards
brief: Normalize math answers, score format separately from correctness, run a timed code reward, and drop reward groups that give GRPO no gradient.
hints: Parse with fractions.Fraction after you expand \\frac and strip the unit. A string compare leaves 1/2 and 0.5 as different answers.
code_reward runs each test in a subprocess with the timeout you were given, and the working directory is a temporary directory. An infinite loop scored in-process never returns.
A group whose rewards are all equal has advantage 0. Drop the whole group. The effective batch size is how many rewards you keep.
